generations.name: Sierra 1500
generations.note: The LS-engine era: simple, strong, and the last of the truly analogue full-size trucks. Denali launched here as an all-wheel-drive luxury trim with the 6.0 V8.

generations.name: Sierra 1500 Denali / AT4
generations.note: Carbon-fibre bed on the Denali, the MultiPro tailgate, a 3.0-litre diesel straight six that's the thinking buy, and the AT4X as the factory off-roader.

models.intro: Chevrolet's Silverado with a premium brief — and in Denali form, the truck that taught American luxury buyers to shop at a GMC store. C/K pickups carried the lineage before the Sierra name took over.
models.name: Sierra 1500

generations.name: Yukon
generations.note: Two-door and four-door trucks on the C/K platform, 5.7 V8, and the start of the full-size SUV era. The two-door GT is the cult pick of the range.

generations.name: Yukon Denali / AT4
generations.note: Independent rear suspension, air ride, and a Denali Ultimate trim with massaging seats and open-pore wood. The AT4 brings the family-truck brief off-road.

models.intro: The Tahoe's plusher twin since 1992. Yukon Denali became so dominant that 'Denali' is effectively GMC's luxury sub-brand, and the current XL is a genuine Escalade alternative.
models.name: Yukon

generations.name: Hummer EV Pickup / SUV
generations.note: Ultium platform, up to 350 kW charging, and Watts to Freedom launching the pickup to 60 mph in about 3 seconds. Weight is the tax: roughly 9,000 lb in Edition 1 form.

models.intro: The Hummer name reborn as a 4-tonne electric flagship: three motors, 1,000 hp, four-wheel steering with CrabWalk, and an open-air roof. Absurd, deliberate, and a genuine halo.
models.name: Hummer EV

models.collectorNote: Roughly half are thought to survive in good order. Original paint and the factory turbo hardware matter; modified trucks are parts donors, originals are investments.

generations.name: Syclone
generations.note: Mitsubishi turbo on the 4.3 V6, a Borg-Warner transfer case sending 65% rearward, and 0–60 in the mid-fours when the Corvette needed five and a half.

models.intro: A turbocharged, all-wheel-drive S-10 that out-accelerated a Ferrari 348 in a famous 1991 comparison test. 2,995 built, all black, and the original American sport truck.
models.name: Syclone
